lastResponse.text: Yes. You did the right thing moving to a lit gas station. If the person who threatened you is nearby, or you feel in immediate danger, call nine one one now. Stay where there are people and lights, keep your phone on low power, and do not go back to camp tonight. I’m connecting you to a live two one one specialist right now to find a safe Place to sleep tonight.
originalTexts: Yes. You did the right thing moving to a lit gas station. If the person who threatened you is nearby, or you feel in immediate danger, call 911 now.
